name: data-backup-manager.catalog-read
purpose: Read registered targets and backup plans together through their owner bindings, following a bounded number of typed cursor pages.

owner.description: Optional owner filter for targets; plans remain the complete owner list.

assumptions: Data Backup Manager is running and its owner list operations are reachable.
invariants: Calls only the declared read-only target and plan list bindings.
An omitted owner returns all targets; a supplied owner filters only targets.
Rows are reduced to the fields needed for catalog triage; complete objects remain available from the owner CLI.
The program fetches at most four pages of 50 rows per list, within the 65,536 byte output budget.
A continuation token after page four is reported as partial; no incomplete list is described as complete.

signals.targets: At most 200 compact target rows with id, owner, name, source kind, locator and critical flag.
signals.plans: At most 200 compact plan rows with identity, schedule, protection tier, selector, target count and destination IDs.
signals.targets_next_page_token: Opaque token from the target response; empty means no further target page.
signals.plans_next_page_token: Opaque token from the plan response; empty means no further plan page.
signals.owner_filter: Owner filter applied to targets, or empty for all targets.
signals.truncated: True when a list continues beyond the four-page scan.

outputs.evidence: The two Data Backup Manager list binding IDs.
